Q: Flutter occurs 'Error connecting to the service protocol: HttpException...' error on iOS device A:

Restarting Device and IDE worked for me

Q: How to Read/Modify the Rating (Popularity Meter) of a .m4a Music File in Python? A:

This is a snippet taken from code using mutagen to modify rating from a personal (non-commercial) project. Pylance complains about using non-public members, but it works without exceptions. You can do similar with the other frame types, like grouping (mutagen.id3.GRP1).

import mutagen.id3

id3file = mutagen.id3.ID3(filename)
for tag in filter(lambda t: t.startswith(("")), id3file):
  frame = id3file[tag]
  if isinstance(frame, mutagen.id3.POPM):
    frame.rating = new_rating
  elif isinstance(frame, mutagen.id3.GRP1):
    frame.group = new_group
id3file.save()

To create a rating where one does not exist, use:

frame = mutagen.id3.POPM(new_rating)
id3file.add(frame)

Q: Pycharm remote debugger is stuck on waiting for connection when running from Pycharm `Cloud Code: Kubernetes` run configuration A:

The issue was with startup command. I was calling the `start-reload.sh` script from https://github.com/tiangolo/uvicorn-gunicorn-docker/blob/master/docker-images/start-reload.sh

## 1. For fastapi services call via python and unicorn

Skaffold's `debug` mode needs to recognize the Python runtime to inject debugpy. It pattern-matches against the container command.

**This works:**
```yaml
command: ["python", "-m", "uvicorn", "service:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8080"]

This doesn't work (shell script wrapper):

command: ["/start-reload.sh"]

Skaffold can't detect Python when it's wrapped in a shell script.

2. Scripts need a delay

From Skaffold's documentation:

"Breakpoints are not hit during program startup. Skaffold configures the containers to run-on-start (continue mode), such that the containers do not wait for the debugger to connect."

For short-lived scripts (unlike long-running servers), add a sleep to give the debugger time to attach:

from time import sleep
import os

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if os.environ.get("ENV") == "dev":
        sleep(20)  # Give debugger time to attach
    
    # Set breakpoints from here onwards
    ...

Set breakpoints after the sleep, and use Cloud Code's Debug mode as usual.

Q: Node Reference Returning Null during @onready A:

Unsurprisingly, this was due to pathing. In my case, $car is a relative path and would directly refer to a child node of the node making the call to $car. So, I had to work backwards up the tree via $../../car. I mostly did this via guessing, but I think that pausing the debugger and some combination of calls to get_parent() and get_children() might have made this easier in retrospect. If I encounter this issue again, that's the method I would use to track down the correct path.

Q: Check if there's been data copied/pasted from a excel file (VBA) A:

There are a few ways you can check if anything has changed in the workbook. I'd suggest this method:

In any (new or existing) standard module, add a public variable declaration at or near the top of the module:

Public wksChanged As Boolean

For each worksheet that you want to monitor for changes, open the Worksheet's module by right-clicking the worksheet's tab and clicking View Code:

...and then add this procedure (to each applicable worksheet module):

Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    wksChanged = True
End Sub

wksChanged will default to False when the workbook is first opened, and will change to True when any cell is changed. You can "reset" it at any time with:

wksChanged = False
